title: Veterinary Expert Inputs for Use of Live Chickens and Chicks in Art Installation at National Gallery Singapore
what_it_is: Veterinary Expert Inputs for Use of Live Chickens and Chicks in Art Installation at National Gallery Singapore

sections.label: NParks licence for poultry exhibition
sections.summary: NParks inspected and licensed the National Gallery Singapore exhibition after assessing poultry food, water, rest and housing, with safeguards by Chicken Rescue Rehome.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The National Parks Board (NParks) assesses all such applications to ensure that they comply with its licensing requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For the art installation that the Member has referred to, NParks conducted a site inspection and obtained the input of one of its veterinarians, before issuing a licence to the National Gallery Singapore (NGS) for the exhibition.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Through the inspection, NParks had assessed that the poultry would be provided with adequate food, water and rest, as well as appropriate housing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NGS also worked closely with Chicken Rescue Rehome (CRR), a local chicken rehoming group, to put in place safeguards such as requiring visitors to keep a distance and to avoid flash photography.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Along with regular checks by CRR representatives and a dedicated team of carers, these measures ensured the well-being of the poultry throughout the five-day exhibition period.

sections.label: Poultry health and future applications
sections.summary: Poultry returned to Ground-Up Initiative were confirmed in good health, and NParks will assess each application carefully, including animal health and welfare.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The last check that we did was when the poultry were returned to the Ground-Up Initiative, which had loaned them to NGS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: When we checked with the organisers, they confirmed that the poultry were in good health.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: On the other question that the Member had on whether this is a trend and if there will be more such exhibitions involving live animals, I cannot speak for event organisers or venues that host such exhibitions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: But what I can assure the Member and his residents is that NParks will assess each application carefully and make sure that they comply with the necessary requirements, including safeguarding animal health and welfare.
